name: AvatarGroup
summary: Several people or teams in one row: overlapping (stack) or side by side (spread), at most `max` faces, the rest behind a "+n" button that lists everyone hidden with their name and role. Built from Avatar and Persona.
a11y: A `group` named by `label`; each avatar is an image named by the person; "+n" is a button named "Show 3 more" that opens a dialog listing them (Escape or a press outside closes it and focus returns to the button).

props.name: members
props.description: Who is in the group (assignees, collaborators, attendees), in a meaningful order: the first ones show.

props.name: label
props.description: What the group is, for assistive technology and the "+n" list's title: "Assignees", "In this document".

props.name: max
props.description: How many avatars show before "+n". The "+n" counts as one of them, so the group never grows past `max`. Default 4.

props.name: layout
props.description: `stack` (default): overlapping with a surface-coloured cut, for tight rows. `spread`: side by side, when each face should be easy to pick out.

props.name: showPresence
props.description: Show each member's presence on their avatar (from 24 px).

props.name: secondary
props.description: A line under the name in the "+n" list: a role or a team.
